description: Project foundation and testable core primitives: scaffold the pinned-dependency TypeScript/Fastify/Vitest project, then build the pure/isolated modules the rest of the service depends on -- domain types, the AppError + ERROR_CODES registry, the integer-cents money module, the in-memory store, the SerialExecutor concurrency primitive, and fail-fast config/seed. This is the dependency base for FEAT-002; it is independent of the HTTP layer. Grounded in design.md Sections 2, 3, 4.1, 5.1, 8 (config), 9 (money), 11 (errors). Folds in F4 (no reservedBy on Coupon) and F5 (crypto.randomUUID id helper).
steps: Create c:\Users\mehul\Desktop\assignment\assignment\be\package.json: type:module; scripts build=`tsc -p tsconfig.json`, test=`vitest run`, dev=`tsx src/server.ts`, start=`tsx src/server.ts`; dependencies fastify + zod and devDependencies typescript + vitest + @types/node + tsx, all EXACT pinned versions (NO ^ or ~). Confirm current compatible versions before pinning.

Create c:\Users\mehul\Desktop\assignment\assignment\be\tsconfig.json (strict:true, module/moduleResolution NodeNext, target ES2022, outDir dist, rootDir src OR include src+test, esModuleInterop), c:\...\be\vitest.config.ts, and c:\...\be\.gitignore (node_modules, dist). Do NOT modify README.md.

Create c:\...\be\src\domain\types.ts: Product, CartLine, Cart (status open|checked_out, orderId), OrderLine, Order (incl. milestoneSequence), Coupon (status available|reserved|redeemed, redeemedByOrderId; NO reservedBy field per F4), IdempotencyRecord (key, cartId, requestFingerprint, status 'completed', orderId, responseBody), Report shape -- per design Section 3 and 12.

Create c:\...\be\src\errors.ts: AppError class {code, httpStatus, message, details?} and the full ERROR_CODES registry + HTTP-status mapping from design Section 11 (VALIDATION_ERROR, INVALID_QUANTITY, PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND, PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE, CART_NOT_FOUND, LINE_NOT_FOUND, ORDER_NOT_FOUND, CART_EMPTY, CART_ALREADY_CHECKED_OUT, INSUFFICIENT_INVENTORY, COUPON_NOT_FOUND, COUPON_NOT_REDEEMABLE, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED, NO_MILESTONE_REACHED, MILESTONE_ALREADY_REWARDED, INTERNAL_ERROR).

Create c:\...\be\src\money.ts: pure integer-cents helpers lineSubtotal(unitPriceCents,qty), sum(numbers), percentDiscount(subtotalCents, percentOff) = clamp(Math.round(subtotalCents*percentOff/100), 0, subtotalCents), and optional formatCents. Add a crypto.randomUUID()-based id helper (here or in a small ids.ts) for cart/order ids per F5.

Create c:\...\be\src\store\store.ts: in-memory store holding Maps for products, carts, orders, coupons, idempotency records, plus generatedMilestones:Set<number>; include test-only setters setProductPrice, adjustInventory, removeProduct used by later failure tests.

Create c:\...\be\src\store\executor.ts: SerialExecutor from design 4.1 (private tail=Promise.resolve(); run<T>(task) chains on tail, swallows rejection on the stored tail so one failure doesn't break the chain, returns the task's own promise). Accept the optional yieldHook only for the unit test, never on the hot path.

Create c:\...\be\src\config.ts: loadConfig(env) using a zod schema -- n integer >=1, x integer in [0,100] -- throwing a clear Error before any listen; export the seed products (>=5, including p_limited with inventory 3) per design 5.1. Defaults n=5, x=10.

Add unit tests: test/money.test.ts (half-up rounding e.g. 1299*10/100 -> 130; discount>=subtotal clamps to subtotal so total>=0; no float), test/executor.test.ts (two tasks submitted before either resolves run strictly FIFO; a throwing task does not break the chain -- next task still runs; uses the yieldHook), test/config.test.ts (throws for n=0, x=101, non-integer; accepts defaults).
acceptance_criteria: `npm install` in be/ succeeds and package.json has only exact pinned versions (no ^ or ~).
`npm run build` exits 0 with strict TypeScript and no errors.
`npx vitest run test/money.test.ts test/executor.test.ts test/config.test.ts` passes all tests.
Coupon type has no reservedBy field (F4); id helper uses crypto.randomUUID (F5).
verification: Run `npm install` then `npm run build` -- both exit 0.
Run `npx vitest run test/money.test.ts test/executor.test.ts test/config.test.ts` -- all green.
Grep package.json manually to confirm no ^/~ remain (support check, not the verification of behavior).
findings:
COMPLETED. Verified: `npm install` ok (154 pkgs); `npm run build` exits 0 under strict NodeNext TS; `npx vitest run test/money.test.ts test/executor.test.ts test/config.test.ts` = 22 tests green. No ^/~ in package.json.

EXACT PINNED VERSIONS (toolchain Node v24.11.0 / npm 11.6.1; chose proven-stable majors over bleeding-edge TS7/vitest5): deps fastify=5.12.5, zod=4.6.5; devDeps typescript=5.9.3, vitest=3.2.7, @types/node=22.20.5, tsx=4.23.15. package.json type:module; scripts build=`tsc -p tsconfig.json`, test=`vitest run`, dev/start=`tsx src/server.ts`. tsconfig: strict, module/moduleResolution NodeNext, target ES2022, outDir dist, rootDir '.', include src+test. ESM import rule: intra-src imports MUST use .js extension (NodeNext), e.g. `import { AppError } from './errors.js'`.

MONEY (src/money.ts, pure): lineSubtotal(unitPriceCents, quantity):number; sum(amounts:number[]):number; percentDiscount(subtotalCents, percentOff):number = clamp(Math.round(subtotalCents*percentOff/100), 0, subtotalCents) (half-up, total never negative); formatCents(cents):string. ID HELPER lives in money.ts (no separate ids.ts): newId(prefix:string):string => `${prefix}_${crypto.randomUUID()}` (F5). Use newId('cart'), newId('order') for cart/order ids.

ERRORS (src/errors.ts): class AppError extends Error {code:ErrorCode; httpStatus:number; logLevel; details?:unknown; toBody()=>{error:{code,message,details?}}}. Constructor: new AppError(code, message, details?) — httpStatus/logLevel derived from ERROR_CODES registry (do NOT pass status). Exports: ErrorCode union, LogLevel, ERROR_CODES record (status+logLevel per Section 11), isAppError(err). Error body shape: {error:{code,message,details?}} — HTTP error-handler (FEAT-002) maps AppError via err.httpStatus/err.toBody() and must translate zod failures to VALIDATION_ERROR 400.

DOMAIN TYPES (src/domain/types.ts): Product{id,name,priceCents,inventory}; CartLine{productId,quantity} (NO prices on line); Cart{id,lines,status:'open'|'checked_out',orderId:string|null,createdAt,updatedAt}; OrderLine{productId,name,unitPriceCents,quantity,lineSubtotalCents}; Order{id,cartId,lines,subtotalCents,discountCents,totalCents,couponCode:string|null,createdAt,milestoneSequence}; Coupon{code,percentOff,milestone,status:'available'|'reserved'|'redeemed',redeemedByOrderId:string|null,createdAt,updatedAt} -- NO reservedBy (F4); IdempotencyRecord{key,cartId,requestFingerprint,status:'completed',orderId,responseBody:unknown}; Report (Section 12 shape incl. coupons{generated,available,reserved,redeemed} and config{n,x}).

STORE (src/store/store.ts): interface Store + createStore(seedProducts:Product[]):Store. Fields: products/carts/orders/coupons/idempotency as Map<string,...>, generatedMilestones:Set<number>. Test-only setters on the store object: setProductPrice(id,priceCents), adjustInventory(id,delta), removeProduct(id). createStore clones seed products.

EXECUTOR (src/store/executor.ts): class SerialExecutor { run<T>(task:()=>Promise<T>):Promise<T> } — private tail=Promise.resolve(); returns the task's own promise while the stored tail swallows rejection so a throwing task does not break the chain. YieldHook type exported (type: (label:string)=>Promise<void>|void) for the unit test ONLY; it is NOT called inside run and must NOT be placed on the checkout hot path.

CONFIG/SEED (src/config.ts): loadConfig(env=process.env):Config{n:number,x:number} — zod validation, fail-fast throws plain Error('invalid REWARD_N...' / 'invalid REWARD_X...') before listen; n integer>=1, x integer in [0,100]; defaults n=5,x=10; env keys REWARD_N/REWARD_X. SEED_PRODUCTS exported const + seedProducts():Product[] (fresh copy each call); 6 products incl. p_limited inventory 3 (ids p_coffee 1299, p_mug 850, p_grinder 7499, p_filters 599, p_scale 3250, p_limited 2500). FEAT-002 buildApp(deps) should call createStore(seedProducts()) and loadConfig().

NOTE for DECISIONS.md: design.md Section 3 still lists Coupon.reservedBy; it was intentionally dropped here per F4 (single-process reservation needs no persistent holder id; DB/multi-instance version would reuse such a column).
